name: crm-autopilot
description: Keeps the CRM current without the owner ever opening it. Creates and updates contacts and deals from email, calendar, and call transcripts; logs activity automatically; drafts follow-ups on deals that have gone quiet; and maintains a next-step queue so nothing sits unowned. Runs on demand or on a schedule, includes a hygiene sweep for duplicates and stale records, and builds a lightweight CRM in a spreadsheet for owners who don't have one. Use this whenever CRM data or pipeline hygiene comes up — including phrasings like "update my CRM," "log this call," "clean up HubSpot," "clean up Salesforce," "add this to the deal," "turn my meeting into a deal note," "which deals have gone quiet," "I hate data entry," or "my pipeline is out of date." Reach for it when the owner describes a call or meeting worth recording, even without naming the CRM.
